title: AgentFold: Closed-Loop Agentic Search for Protein Folding Model Design
abstract: arXiv:2608.26747v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific LLM agents have shown promise in literature reasoning, tool use, and experiment planning, but it remains unclear whether they can autonomously improve large, tightly coupled scientific machine-learning systems through executable code changes and computationally expensive validation. We study this question in protein folding, where progress requires coordinated architectural modifications, multi-objective evaluation, and domain-aware interpretation. We present AgentFold, a multi-agent framework that formulates folding-model development as a closed-loop search over executable code variants. Starting from ESMFold, AgentFold proposes hypotheses, implements and debugs code-level modifications, evaluates model variants, analyzes experimental outcomes, and stores both successful and failed interventions in structured memory. translated_title: AgentFold：用于蛋白质折叠模型设计的闭环智能体搜索
translated_abstract: 摘要：科学大型语言模型智能体在文献推理、工具使用和实验规划方面显示出潜力，但仍不清楚它们能否通过可执行的代码更改和计算成本高昂的验证，自主改进大型、紧密耦合的科学机器学习系统。我们在蛋白质折叠领域研究这一问题，该领域的进展需要协调架构修改、多目标评估和领域感知解释。我们提出了AgentFold，一个多智能体框架，将折叠模型开发形式化为对可执行代码变体的闭环搜索。从ESMFold开始，AgentFold提出假设、实现并调试代码级修改、评估模型变体、分析实验结果，并将成功和失败的干预存储在结构化记忆中。一种基于蒙特卡洛树搜索的策略在高分搜索分支间分配计算资源。在工程层面...
tldr: AgentFold提出了一种多智能体闭环搜索框架，通过代码级修改和结构化记忆，实现蛋白质折叠模型的自主优化与多目标评估。
en_tdlr: AgentFold presents a closed-loop multi-agent search framework that autonomously optimizes protein folding models through code-level modifications and structured memory, enabling multi-objective evaluation and iterative improvement.
